olivia (support): FYI getting a bunch of 404s after a customer upgraded to @redwood/sdk v0.19.0. They call client.chat.create(...) and server returns 404. docs show chat.create in examples though. anyone seen this?

sam (sdk-eng): which exact package? ts or node package? can you paste package.json deps + exact error body?

olivia (support): node SDK, package.json line: 
```json
"@redwood/inference": "^0.19.0"
```
error body: `{"error":"not_found","path":"/v1/chat.create"}`

olivia (support): request snippet the customer used: 
```js
const client = new RedwoodClient();
await client.chat.create({ model: 'redwood-1', messages })
```

tess (devex): hmm, last release notes mentioned some route normalizations (slash vs dot) for consistency. maybe the package published had mismatched route map. Can you repro locally by installing 0.19.0?

olivia (support): I tried locally in a fresh node container, same 404. When I curl the raw API path that our control plane expects (`POST /v1/chat/create`) it works. So the client is likely using `/v1/chat.create` while server expects `/v1/chat/create` — casing/delimiter mismatch.

sam (sdk-eng): thanks — could be a bad route mapping in the client generated types. quick check: can you run `node -e "console.log(require('@redwood/inference').routes.chat)"` in that container and paste output?

olivia (support): output: "chat.create"

sam (sdk-eng): there we go. The SDK shipped a dot-notation route key instead of the path-style. That's our bug. Two immediate options: downgrade to 0.18.1 which still uses path-style, or as a workaround call the REST path directly.

olivia (support): shared workaround for customer: 
```js
// direct REST until we patch SDK
await fetch(process.env.REDWOOD_API_URL + '/v1/chat/create', {
  method: 'POST',
  headers: { 'Authorization': `Bearer ${API_KEY}`, 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
  body: JSON.stringify({ model: 'redwood-1', messages })
})
```

sam (sdk-eng): can you also paste the version string from package-lock? sometimes npm flattens and a different version sneaks in.

olivia (support): package-lock top-level: `@redwood/inference@0.19.0` — validated. Customer tried pinning 0.18.1 and that fixed it.

sam (sdk-eng): ok I'm going to draft a patch to regenerate the route mapping and publish 0.19.1. Will also add an integration test that compares route keys -> actual HTTP paths.

eng-sdk-bot: issue created: RW-8432 "sdk: route key format regression in v0.19.0" assigned to @sam, priority P1

sam (sdk-eng): planned fix: regenerate client from latest API schema, publish 0.19.1 with migrations notes. ETA ~2 hours if CI is green.

olivia (support): I'll notify the affected customer and recommend pin to 0.18.1 or the direct REST workaround. Also adding repro steps to the support ticket. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: npm publish successful: @redwood/inference@0.19.1 (patch)

sam (sdk-eng): pushed hotfix and added release note: "Fix route key formatting that caused 404s for chat.* methods. If you see 404s after upgrading, pin to 0.18.x or upgrade to 0.19.1."

tess (devex): leaving a follow-up task to add a changelog lint that catches route key vs path mismatches in future releases.

olivia (support): customer confirmed upgrade to 0.19.1 fixed their 404s. closing ticket. thanks everyone! :tada:
